'''''Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner''''' was a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] convoy [[Raid on Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner|ambushed]] by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in the [[Chorax system/Legends|Chorax system]]. After losing all its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escorts, the convoy surrendered and delivered their cargo to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in need of bacta like [[Halanit]].<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
